cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Draw another route for our parade with me. Two streets said no; the town hasn't. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then take the other pencil. Can you picture people cheering by the loading bay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on the map. Where would a second person stand?

mechanism: A directs a reduced parade plan, accepts B unpromising route and recruits B to imagine attendance from one plausible supporter.
confusable: Unlike merely declaring success, A seeks B shared belief in a still-possible outcome; borrowed authority uses B small workable contribution to keep planning alive.
comparison: A parade behind a supermarket differs from imagining customers for a waiting-list cafe.
seedUse: Use D103-a route refusals/loading bay/Dad/map with S02-a revising the plan to the helper viable option.
